audience.description: Adults who treat their cat or dog as family. They share pet photos constantly, plan seasonal pet outfits the way they plan their own, and want cozy, well-made pieces that look good on camera and survive the wash. They enjoy humor, warmth and small everyday rituals with their animals.

brief.productRole: The mustard knit beanie and rust-red sweater are put on pets on screen. A hand eases the beanie over a dog's head and through the ear openings, then clicks the adjustable strap. A cat steps calmly into the sweater. The pets then go about their day (trotting, sitting in a window, curling up), showing the stretch yarn moving with them. The last beat shows the sweater going into a washing machine drum, then the folded pieces next to the pom-pom beanie.
brief.mood: Cozy, funny, heartwarming, with a little mock-serious fashion confidence

music.style: Upbeat indie pop with a warm, bouncy feel: plucked acoustic guitar, soft hand claps, light glockenspiel, and a gentle bass groove with a small whistle hook. Add a playful record-scratch-free pause on the reveal.

visual.look: Warm autumn grade with golden highlights and soft creamy shadows, light film grain. Shot at pet eye level with a 35mm-style lens, shallow depth of field, and occasional macro close-ups of the knit texture and pom-pom. Handheld but steady. Quick cuts of about 1 to 1.5 seconds, a slow-motion beat on the pom-pom bounce, and a final locked-off frame of the product on a wooden surface.

wardrobe.styling: Pets wear the product: a mustard knit beanie with pom-pom and ear openings on a medium dog, the rust-red knit sweater on a short-haired cat, plus a matching knit bandana on a small dog. No logos, no text. Only a small fabric tag with a paw symbol shows.

types: sunlit apartment living room with a wide window seat
autumn sidewalk park path with fallen leaves
small laundry nook with a front-loading washer

voice.tone: Warm, dry-witted and affectionate, like a proud pet parent who also runs a fashion house
use: Speak as the brand with short, playful lines
Treat the pets as the stars with mock-runway confidence
Mention soft stretch yarn, adjustable straps, machine washable, and new colors each season
End with a simple invitation to shop
avoid: Ratings, review counts or best seller language
Speaking as a customer who tried it
Slang tied to a specific community

hooks: Your dog called. He wants a sweater.
Meet the most dressed one in the house.
Cat in a sweater: zero regrets, full confidence.
